work.summary: Closed the bounded FINAL.20 OCR continuation maintenance cycle. Same-visit related papers may preserve different maker/vendor identities when they share a trusted machine, eliminating the real-device `Visit vendor mismatch` while retaining fail-closed behavior without same-machine evidence. OCR now starts automatically on capture and the read button is retry-only. PR #114 merged, production Vercel is READY, production affected gates/smoke pass, GitHub Pages serves FINAL.20, and the live continuation gate passes.
implemented: Reordered report↔visit reconciliation to validate/inherit machineId before vendor-key enforcement.

A report with no machineId inherits the visit's trusted machineId; once report and visit resolve to the same machine, differing vendorKey values are permitted without overwriting the report vendor identity.
If no trusted same-machine context exists, vendor mismatch still throws `Visit vendor mismatch`.
If report and visit have different machineId values, `Visit machine mismatch` still fails closed.
Capture selection now calls OCR automatically when the secure OCR adapter is available.
The normal OCR button is hidden; it is exposed as `もう一度読み取る` only after OCR failure or when the adapter is unavailable.

Added a dedicated browser/IndexedDB regression gate for same-machine/different-vendor continuation, fail-closed vendor mismatch without machine context, fail-closed machine mismatch, automatic OCR source wiring, FINAL.20, and 320px layout.
